idea-plugin.name: Claude DesignKit for Compose
idea-plugin.description:
Turn a design system exported from Claude Design into ready-to-use Jetpack Compose code in your Android module.

What it generates
  • Theme: AppTheme with light/dark colors, type scale, shapes, spacing, elevation and size tokens, mapped onto Material 3. Each token keeps the design's usage note as KDoc.
  • Icons without duplicates: icons the design uses that already exist in Material Icons are referenced, not copied. Material Symbols names map to the Compose icon of the same name; SVG icons that match a Material icon's shape are reused. Only custom icons are generated, as ImageVector or vector drawables.
  • Components: AppButton, AppTextField, AppCard, AppChip and AppBadge, with the variants defined in the design's CSS, each with @Previews.
  • Localization: bilingual UI text in the prototype is merged into values/strings.xml and values-ar/strings.xml, inside a marked block that re-imports replace without touching your own strings.
How to use
  1. Export your design system from Claude Design (zip or folder).
  2. Run Tools › Import Claude Design System… and pick the export.
  3. Review the preview: target module, package, icon format, which Material icons to reuse and which strings to include.
  4. Click Import. Run Re-import Claude Design System whenever the design changes.
Re-imports only touch files the plugin generated; hand-written files are never overwritten. The plugin also adds the Material icons dependency to your module when it's needed.

Independent plugin, not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.
